items.title: Israel re-establishes closed West Bank settlement, defying growing international protests
items.description: Thirty "pioneer families" have arrived on a wave of nationalism driven by Israel's government, but the rapid change has left nearby Palestinian residents fearful.

items.title: Rosenberg: Shortage of petrol but not patriotism as Russians feel growing impact of war
items.description: Drivers are waiting hours in fuel queues, as Moscow prepares to celebrate Russian Flag Day.

items.title: Hong Kong's Tiananmen activists guilty in national security trial
items.description: Three activists were accused of inciting others to subvert state power under the China-introduced law.

items.title: Two teenagers seriously injured after sword attack at Swedish school
items.description: Police say one man has been arrested, while several other local schools were locked down.

items.title: Ebola vaccine trial to start in DR Congo as warning issued over speed of infections
items.description: About half of the 2,500 recorded deaths from Ebola happened in the last 20 days, the WHO says.

items.title: Five missing after fire in Swiss Alpine town

items.title: Peru earthquake damages buildings and causes power cuts

items.title: Ethiopia's Virgin Mary festival in Tigray cancelled over drone strike fears
items.description: An eagerly anticipated gathering of women will not be taking place following recent aerial strikes.

items.title: Pakistan ex-PM Imran Khan back in jail after hospital examination

items.title: Bodies of two hikers missing for decades found after Swiss glacier melts

items.description: The overloaded boat was taking people, including many children, to farms to harvest rice.

items.title: Panama Canal to cut number of ships passing through due to El Niño

items.title: How much could Trump's 'economic D-Day' hurt Iran?

items.title: Broken toilets, leaking roofs: Why India's 'cockroach' party wants to fix schools
items.description: The poor state of government schools is the focus of a new campaign by India's Cockroach Janta Party (CJP).
